result:
Three merged PRs since 2026-04-11 added or removed a line containing `configUrls` under `packages/tooling/openmrs`. Listed best first, with merge dates taken from the squash-commit dates:

1. **#1905**, "Rewrite the openmrs CLI README around how it's used", merged **2026-10-02** (`b439966ee59c5a9d0cc569942c6fb6d98bb28ba4`). It adds `configUrls` lines to the README (lines 185, 199, 213) and rewrites the `configUrls` wording in the `cli.ts` epilog (lines 403, 406).
2. **#1894**, "Remove offline & rxjs support from framework", merged **2026-09-28** (`a62f8164991a64135f438cef848fdc751e866d20`). It removes a `configUrls` line from the `cli.ts` epilog and changes the `configUrls` destructuring in `develop.ts`.
3. **#1743**, "Drop IMO and don't load arbitrary content in production mode", merged **2026-04-15** (`1dcccfd421c94ee0f0a8aa6c7c974cadab3d5fb8`). It changes the `configUrls` test call in `config.test.ts` from `loadBundlerConfig` to `setBundlerEnv`.

Checked and not qualifying: `build.ts`, `config.ts`, `debug.ts`, `build.integration.test.ts` and `develop.integration.test.ts`. Their `configUrls` matches are unchanged context lines in the diffs.

I took "the pinned head" to be `main` at `7a172083` (the default-branch HEAD). No later commit changed a `configUrls` line.

Evidence:
- openmrs-esm-core/packages/tooling/openmrs/README.md:185-213 (#1905 added `configUrls` lines)
- openmrs-esm-core/packages/tooling/openmrs/src/cli.ts:398-410 (epilog with `configUrls`, changed by #1894 and #1905)
- openmrs-esm-core/packages/tooling/openmrs/src/commands/develop.ts:19-27 (`configUrls` in destructuring, changed by #1894)
- openmrs-esm-core/packages/tooling/openmrs/src/utils/config.test.ts:29-32 (`configUrls` test call, changed by #1743)
